نكتري (form VIII)
# نَكْتَرِي (naktarī) /nak.ta.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# نَكْتَرِيَ (naktariya) /nak.ta.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
